name: megin
description: Portable Megin Workflow v3 for evidence-linked planning, executable behavior contracts, independent review, human acceptance, and local delivery.

interface.shortDescription: Align behavior, implementation, tests, review, and human acceptance.
interface.longDescription: Megin v3 asks evidence-based questions, binds executable Gherkin to one approved plan, dispatches independent writer and reviewer loops, waits for human acceptance, then updates knowledge and creates one local commit.
defaultPrompt: Describe the behavior you need and let Megin explore the codebase before asking one decision at a time.
Approve the Chat Summary and File Details once, then let Megin dispatch BDD/TDD tasks and independent reviews.
Run the approved verification, perform human acceptance, and create one local commit only after acceptance.
